summary: Loads image or video files (PNG, JPG, EXR, MP4, HAP, NotchLC, etc.) from disk into a texture. Supports image sequences and looping.

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: Movie, image, folder sequence, or URL source

key_params.name: reload
key_params.note: Reload parameter tuple containing reload pulse

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Explicit movie index for Specify Index mode

key_params.name: imageindexing
key_params.note: zero or filename for image sequences

key_params.name: inputcolorspace
key_params.note: Input color-space treatment before GPU upload

key_params.name: prereadframes
key_params.note: Number of frames to read ahead

key_params.name: hwdecode
key_params.note: Use supported hardware decode where applicable

common_gotchas: Movie index values are movie-frame indices, not project timeline frame numbers.
Folder sequences sort alphanumerically unless filename-based image indexing is selected.
pre-read improves heavy playback but consumes memory and CPU resources.
hwdecode does not help Hap or NotchLC because those formats are already hardware decoded.
The official parameter is prereadframes, not the stale preread name.
key_concepts: Loads movie files, still images, image sequences, folders of images, and supported URLs into TOPs.
Movie index values refer to the sequence of images in the movie file, not the global project frame rate.
Play Mode selects timeline-locked, explicit index, sequential, or timecode-driven playback.
Image sequence indexing can be zero-based after alphanumeric sorting or filename-based.
Tune and decode controls manage pre-reading, hardware decode, timeouts, HTTP predownload, and CPU decode resources.
Info CHOP channels expose open, decode, read-ahead, and hardware-decode state for diagnostics.
